blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two Filipino seafarers sustained minor injuries after their vessel came under an apparent drone attack in the Black Sea, but all 19 Filipino crew members were safely rescued by the Bulgarian military, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Thursday. DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said the seafarers were staying at a hotel in Bulgaria after escaping their Liberian-flagged vessel, which tilted following the attack and appeared to be at risk of sinking. “All 19 are safe and sound.
